clusters.title: [Impact] win32k-wpf on Config2 - Win32k may change WPF windowing or DPI
clusters.body:
<!-- impact:win32k-wpf:Config2 -->

Impact analysis conducted on source code version:

- https://github.com/defrances/HostApplication - commit `22b249a754b849dac151e976b533f60994fc6098`

## Updates applicable for this product configuration

| Title | Package | CVEs | Recommendation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Windows Win32k Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability | [KB5099444](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-50688) | CVE-2026-50688 | Install - High Prio |
| Windows Win32k Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability | [KB5099535](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-54986) | CVE-2026-54986 | Install - High Prio |
| Win32k Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability | [KB5099444](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-49805) | CVE-2026-49805 | Install - High Prio |
| Windows Win32k Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability | [KB5099536](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-54112) | CVE-2026-54112 | Install - High Prio |
| Windows Win32k Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability | [KB5099444](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-56176) | CVE-2026-56176 | Install - High Prio |
| Win32k Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability | [KB5099444](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-57095) | CVE-2026-57095 | Install - High Prio |

## Product Configuration Specification

- Product configuration: Config2
- Model / role: LabBench-L110 / lab-analysis-workstation
- Deployment group: lab-ring-0
- OS: Windows 11 IoT Enterprise build 10.0.26100.4200
- Clinical criticality: high
- Network exposure: restricted_lan

## Vendor vs product scores

| | Severity | Likelihood | Risk |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Vendor | H | H | H |
| Product | M | M | M |

Letters are C / H / M / L. Vendor comes from FindUpdates severity, KEV, and exploitability. Product is allowed to be lower when the patched component is not loaded.

## Technical Impact Assessment

### Impacted Components

- `src/HostApplication/HostApplication.csproj` — `UseWPF`, WinExe, `net9.0-windows`.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — `dotnet publish` `--self-contained true` `-r win-x64`.
- `src/HostApplication.Core/NoteStore.cs` — `%AppData%\HostApplication\notes.txt`.
- `src/HostApplication.Core/SystemInformation.cs` — `RuntimeInformation` host strings.
- `src/HostApplication/app.manifest` — Windows 10 compatibility and `PerMonitorV2`.
- `src/HostApplication.Core/InsecureVendorBulletinClient.cs` — HTTPS via host Schannel.
- SBOM present at `workspace/sbom/HostApplication.sbom.spdx.json`.

### Potential Risks

- **Required for the app to keep working: Not required.** The exe still starts without this KB. WPF is bundled by self-contained publish; this is a host windowing KB, not a product `PackageReference`.
- **If we install: App may break.** A host Win32k/DWM KB can change DPI or composition used by `MainWindow.xaml` and `app.manifest` (`PerMonitorV2`).
- **If we skip: Station stays exposed.** Leaving the KB off leaves that host windowing stack unpatched. The WPF UI can still launch.
- **Compatibility: Unknown.** We did not prove an API/ABI break against current `main`; windowing/DPI after the KB is not covered by a UI test.

### Conclusions

Win32k may change WPF windowing or DPI. Current `main` has no third-party PackageReference. CI publishes a self-contained win-x64 exe, so an OS .NET KB does not patch the bundled runtime.

## Cybersecurity impact assessment

This patch fixes CVE-2026-50688, CVE-2026-54986, CVE-2026-49805, CVE-2026-54112, CVE-2026-56176, CVE-2026-57095 in KB5099444, KB5099535, KB5099536. SBOM scan and source code scan revealed that the WPF UI module has such host windowing dependency.

## Product Risk assessment

- Affected product functions: WPF windowing, DPI, and composition.
- Potential hazards: operator cannot read the UI if windowing or DPI breaks after the host KB.
- Failure scenarios: install — layout or DPI may break; skip — host windowing stays exposed.

## Test Planning

### Recommended Regression Suite

- None. No documented test covers this coupling.

### Gap Analysis

- No Unit, Smoke, or Regression case in `docs/test-plan.md` for this host path.
- No UI automation.

## Recommendation

Install - High Prio: lab-check the published win-x64 build for Config2 against this `win32k-wpf` coupling. Do not instruct production install from this analysis.

| | Severity | Likelihood | Risk |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Vendor | H | M | M |
| Product | M | M | M |

Letters are C / H / M / L. Vendor comes from FindUpdates severity, KEV, and exploitability. Product is allowed to be lower when the patched component is not loaded.

## Technical Impact Assessment

### Impacted Components

- `src/HostApplication/HostApplication.csproj` — `UseWPF`, WinExe, `net9.0-windows`.

- Affected product functions: process launch and exe identity.
- Potential hazards: operator cannot start the client if Shell identity handling changes.
- Failure scenarios: install — launch may fail; skip — host Shell stays exposed.

## Test Planning

### Recommended Regression Suite

- None. No documented test covers this coupling.

### Gap Analysis

- No Unit, Smoke, or Regression case in `docs/test-plan.md` for this host path.
- No UI automation.

## Recommendation

Install - High Prio: lab-check the published win-x64 build for Config2 against this `shell-launch` coupling. Do not instruct production install from this analysis.
